name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
blurb: Progress bar at the top of the page showing scroll position.
description: A fixed position bar that scales horizontally based on page scroll progress. Uses Framer Motion's useScroll hook with a hardcoded gradient background.
use_when: A page indicator showing reading progress or engagement depth in long-form content.
avoid_when: When page content doesn't have enough vertical space to scroll meaningfully.
a11y: Decorative visual indicator only. Conveys scroll progress visually but has no semantic role, label, or keyboard interaction.
